_comment: Outside-cone task under a bounded disturbance (UE-bCBF) with the stock-x500 limits (thrust 1.99-14.95 m/s^2, roll/pitch +-3.84 rad/s, yaw +-0.203 rad/s; hover LQR re-weighted for them, docker_batch/configs/landing_x500_cone45_r0p3.json). Base set: the 9-D hover ellipsoid beside the funnel at c_B = 20 (bounds: c_U 28.66, c_chart 103.1, c_geometric 22.20 binding, c_Lyap >= 28.66). Design region: speed <= 2 m/s and yaw <= 25 deg (what the 0.203 rad/s yaw rate can undo within the 2 s backup horizon). Reference: the slow approach L3-1-s (0.6 m/s average, 1.31 m/s peak, 7.6 s). See docker_batch/README_x500_ue.md for how base_set_c and the disturbance bound were checked.
